notes: STAGING DEPLOYED: build 8ea2f811-ce76-4518-93da-c2e6c345f27a exit 0, revision sahayakai-agents-staging-00038-mxt. _STAGING_SUFFIX was NOT passed and took its cloudbuild default '-staging'. Production sahayakai-agents remained on sahayakai-agents-00032-tqb, checked before and after.

Probe 10/10 PASS, committed at sahayakai-agents/scripts/probe_vidya_live_staging.py and refusing to run against any URL without '-staging' (exercised against the prod URL: exit 2). A1 valid token decoded 11114 audio bytes. A2 garbage token: client rejected AND zero stream_open in the Cloud Logging window, with a stream_rejected present in the same window so that 'no stream_open' proves something rather than proving the request never arrived. A3 replay rejected as token_replayed. A4 seventh open rejected as uid_hourly_rate_limit.

The staging deploy path was ALREADY BROKEN before this work, from 054869568: the audience-override sed wrote its replacement text at the indentation the rendered spec needs, but inside a YAML block scalar with an indent indicator of 8, so the env entry landed two levels out and gcloud rejected the file. Both existing guards missed it because each matched the value anywhere on the line. Fixed in 0250b31ec with the guards anchored to exact indentation.

FINDING: the 4409/4429 close codes never reach a deployed client. Every rung rejects before ws.accept(), and uvicorn answers a pre-accept close with HTTP 403, discarding the code. They survive only in stream_rejected.reason. Nothing is accepted and nothing is billed, so this is not a hole — but the codes are a server-side taxonomy, not a client contract, and any client written against them will be disappointed.

The probe needs X-Serverless-Authorization because the app itself owns the Authorization header. That means U1.2's planned move of the stream token to 'Authorization: Bearer' cannot coexist with Cloud Run IAM auth for a client that must put a Google ID token in Authorization. Confirm how the Flutter client authenticates before the ?t= fallback is deleted.

NOT PROVEN: the 4503 global-capacity rung was not probed (it would cost 24 simultaneous billable Live sessions). A4's per-uid guarantee was observed on a single instance and is per-process by design; it was not tested across a scale-out.

head: 780b237da21393f017b42f846b70f6db2ec0f893
notes: Not attempted rather than half-attempted. The diagnostics panel could be built blind, but its whole purpose is to report numbers observed on a real handset — frames up, bytes down, tool calls, WS close code, whether the fallback was taken. Building the panel without a device would ship an unread instrument and let the unit be recorded as progress.

The on-device protocol is written and ready in the plan: flag ON, speak the Hindi lesson-plan request, expect an audible reply AND navigation to /lesson-plan with fields prefilled; speak over the reply and expect playback to stop; airplane mode mid-session; flag OFF (turn-based still works end to end); server flag unset (503, silent fallback). Capture adb logcat -s flutter plus a screen recording.

Note for whoever runs it: the sidecar is already deployed and verified on STAGING (revision sahayakai-agents-staging-00038-mxt, probe 10/10), so the device test can run against staging without waiting for any PR to merge.
